query:
SELECT course_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        MIN(embedding <#> $1) AS distance
    FROM course_prerequisites
    GROUP BY course_id
    ORDER BY distance ASC
    LIMIT 5
) t
UNION ALL
SELECT course_id
FROM course_prerequisites
WHERE to_tsvector('english', prerequisite)
@@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $2)
